name: ECON 2120
title: Honors Core: Rights and Harms
description: Basic concepts in the economics and philosophy of law as a framework for discussing controversial social issues. Topics may include intellectual property rights, eminent domain, freedom of speech, and "repugnant" transactions like the sale of human organs. CA 1.
requirement_description: Any 1000-level course in Economics, which may be taken concurrently; open to students in the Honors program; others by instructor permission.
